import urllib.request, json
# Explore document types
url = 'https://www.federalregister.gov/api/v1/documents.json?conditions%5Bterm%5D=proposed+rule&per_page=5&fields%5B%5D=title&fields%5B%5D=abstract&fields%5B%5D=document_number&fields%5B%5D=type&fields%5B%5D=raw_text_url&order=newest'
data = json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=15).read())

    print(f"Type: {r.get('type')}, Doc: {r.get('document_number')}, Title: {r.get('title')[:80]}...")
    print(f"  Abstract: {r.get('abstract')[:200] if r.get('abstract') else 'None'}...")
    print()
